slots.jd.food-processing.about:
Position summary
Orchard Foods Corporation seeks an HR Coordinator to support human resources operations at its food-processing facility in Fresno, California. The coordinator will serve as a point of contact for employees and managers on routine HR matters and will work on site with the plant leadership team.
Minimum: prior HR support experience, working knowledge of HR information systems, and clear written communication.
Preferred: experience in a manufacturing or food-processing setting.
slots.jd.food-processing.duties:
Responsibilities
- Answer employee questions about benefits enrollment, eligibility and coverage changes
- Maintain accurate and confidential HR records in the HR information system
- Communicate policy updates to employees and supervisors across production shifts
- Update employee files to reflect changes in status, pay and job assignments
- Assist with audits of HR records and follow up on missing documentation
slots.jd.food-processing.needs:
Minimum and preferred qualifications
- 2 or more years of experience in an HR coordinator or HR support role
- Working experience with payroll coordination and applicant tracking
- Demonstrated ability to manage new hire onboarding and performance review cycles
- Experience supporting employee relations matters and conducting exit interviews
- Preferred: HR Practitioner Certificate
slots.r1.b1: Updates review policy guidance and communicates changes ahead of performance review cycles, reducing late review submissions by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Maintains accurate employee HR records and prepares compliance reporting from those records for review by the HR team.
slots.r1.b3: Schedules candidate interviews through Workday and coordinates calendars with hiring managers, cutting the time needed to book interviews by 40 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Screens incoming candidates against role requirements and supports payroll coordination for new hires once offers are accepted.
slots.r1.i1: Coordinates interview scheduling at Elmstead Partners, arranging candidate meetings and keeping hiring managers informed of each step.
slots.r1.i2: Supports policy updates at Elmstead Partners as HR Coordinator, sharing changes with employees and keeping related HR documents current.
slots.summary.1: Associate-level human resources professional with about 2 years of experience handling routine HR requests, with a colleague checking the completed work. Skills include payroll coordination, applicant tracking and day-to-day use of Workday.
slots.summary.2: HR coordinator with about 2 years of experience supporting routine employee and hiring requests under review by a senior colleague. Works in Workday for applicant tracking and payroll coordination tasks.
